rules.content:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Sextortion-Investment Hybrid Escalation")`
`comment("Detects escalating crypto payments following new social contact")`
index=flame_banking sourcetype=flame:transaction_monitoring
  (payment_type="cryptocurrency" OR payment_type="crypto_deposit" OR payment_type="wire_to_crypto_exchange")
  is_first_crypto_period="true"
  days_since_account_first_crypto<=60
| stats count AS transaction_count,
        min(amount) AS first_amount,
        max(amount) AS last_amount,
        sum(amount) AS total_amount,
        dc(crypto_address) AS unique_crypto_addresses,
        earliest(transaction_date) AS first_txn_date,
        latest(transaction_date) AS last_txn_date
  BY account_id
| where transaction_count >= 3
| eval escalation_ratio = last_amount / first_amount
| where escalation_ratio >= 3.0
| eval risk_score = case(
    escalation_ratio > 10 AND total_amount > 50000, "critical",
    escalation_ratio > 5 AND total_amount > 10000, "high",
    1=1, "medium")
| table account_id, transaction_count, first_amount, last_amount,
        escalation_ratio, total_amount, unique_crypto_addresses,
        first_txn_date, last_txn_date, risk_score
| sort - total_amount
rules.title: DL-0172: Sextortion-Investment Hybrid Fraud — Small Payment Escalation to Crypto Addresses with Communication Pattern Shift (SPLUNK)
